name: runut-tim
description: Reconstructs project history from chats, documents and tasks, only from what the asker may see, with a source on every sentence.

displayDescription.en: Rebuilds why a project happened the way it did from chats, documents and tasks. Every sentence cites its source, open items come from the task board, and gaps in the record are named with who likely knows. It only searches what the asker is allowed to see.
displayDescription.zh: 从聊天、文档和任务还原项目来龙去脉，每句注明出处，列出未结事项和记录缺口，只查提问者有权看的内容。
